login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sword Brazil alliance members only. Sign in with the username and password the administrator created for you.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator to set a new one.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask an alliance administrator.
login.rememberHint: Skip the login on your next visits, for up to 30 days. Unchecked, you sign in again after closing the browser. Don't check it on shared devices.

fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a lowercase letter, an UPPERCASE letter, a digit and a symbol.
